items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They always talk about—I think Paderewski said, “ If I missed two days practice, I know it. If I miss four days practice, my wife knows it. If I miss six days practice, everybody knows it.”

ctx.x: Well, actually I felt better because I was more active. You see, the more active you are the better you can play. It is when you become an active, that is when you're playing suffers. They always talk about—I think Paderewski said, “ If I missed two days practice, I know it. If I miss four days practice, my wife knows it. If I miss six days practice, everybody knows it.” (Laughs) that thinking, that line of thinking got me.
So, in a way, that residency provided you the outlet the show didn’t provide?
